title: TBD Map Object Instance (catalog v1 placement row)
description: One placed object. Compact: references its prefab by index; never duplicates kind/class/resourceName/bounds (resolve via prefabs[prefabId]). T-090.2. Three equivalent JSON encodings: an expanded object (golden/readability), a legacy id-first positional array [id, prefabId, x, y, z?, rotationDeg?], or the chunk wire tuple — [prefabId, x, y, z, rotationDeg] (T-090.3.1) or, since objects schemaVersion 1.1.0 (T-090.12.1), [prefabId, x, y, z, rotationDeg, pitchDeg, rollDeg, scale] (all numbers; id derived as {cx}_{cy}:{index}). Discriminator: element 0 string = legacy tuple, element 0 number = chunk tuple. A FOURTH encoding of the same row exists and is NOT JSON: the 32-byte ObjectInstancePod inside a TBDC container (T-935, spec §2/§3.1), documented byte-for-byte at $defs/objectInstancePodRow below.

objectInstancePodRow.title: ObjectInstancePod — the 32-byte binary row (T-935.1, spec §2)
objectInstancePodRow.description: NOT a JSON Schema validator (JSON Schema cannot describe bytes) — this is the wire contract for objects/chunks/{cx}_{cy}.bin, recorded beside the JSON rows it encodes so the two cannot drift apart unnoticed. One .bin is a 32-byte TbdcHeader followed by `count` of these and nothing else, so byte offset of row i is 32 + 32 * i and the whole ingest is a length check plus one bytemuck::cast_slice. All fields little-endian; the struct is #[repr(C)] with no padding, which is what the field ORDER below buys. A 5-wide JSON row decodes with pitchDeg = rollDeg = 0 and scale = 1. Live definition: crates/map-engine-core/src/world/binary/pod.rs; the manifest names it as objects.binary.pod / podBytes so a loader can refuse a shape it does not implement. Checked by `cargo xtask schema terrain-manifest` (arithmetic: no gap, no overlap, total = POD_BYTES) and by golden_gate S15, which decodes the committed golden .bin at these very offsets.

fields.name: yaw
fields.unit: degrees; the JSON row's rotationDeg, Enfusion GetAngles() heading about Y

fields.name: scale
fields.unit: uniform GetScale(); 1.0 when the source row is 5-wide

fields.name: prefab_id
fields.unit: index into the prefab catalogue; the prefabIdx SoA column

fields.name: class_code
fields.unit: render-class code, 255 = NO_CLASS; derived from the prefab catalogue, not carried by the JSON row

fields.name: _pad
fields.unit: always 0 — present so the struct is exactly 32 B with no compiler padding a Pod cast would expose as uninitialised

oneOf.description: Legacy positional tuple [id, prefabId, x, y, z?, rotationDeg?] (T-110 binary compile input). Position 0 is the string id; 1 is the integer prefabId; 2..5 are numbers (x, y, z?, rotationDeg?).

Chunk wire tuple [prefabId, x, y, z, rotationDeg] (T-090.3.1, plan §3.2) or, since objects schemaVersion 1.1.0 (T-090.12.1), [prefabId, x, y, z, rotationDeg, pitchDeg, rollDeg, scale] — all numbers, exactly 5 or 8 wide (never 6 or 7). The trailing three are written only when non-trivial (pitchDeg != 0 or rollDeg != 0 or scale != 1 after rounding: angles 2 dp, scale 3 dp); a reader missing them assumes 0, 0, 1. Angle order is Enfusion GetAngles(): pitch about X, heading about Y (rotationDeg), roll about Z; scale is the entity's uniform GetScale(). Instance id is derived from chunk file + index ({cx}_{cy}:{index}), unique by construction (G5). Written by objects/chunks/{cx}_{cy}.json.gz only.
